import type { BreadcrumbContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Breadcrumb extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        home: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        currentItem: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        omitCurrent: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        maxVisible: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        narrow: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    items: BreadcrumbContract['items'];
    home: BreadcrumbContract['home'];
    currentItem: BreadcrumbContract['currentItem'];
    omitCurrent: boolean;
    maxVisible: number;
    private narrow;
    private media?;
    constructor();
    private resize;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
